_about: Session 1315 (chain 096): the stored runs of Ask's evaluations, one list read by history.py, replay.py and refusals.py. Each run: its file, its grades file and the field of a grade that says right (none when the run carries its own grades), its label, the tool-call limit of the day it was asked, whether it carries a tool record (replayed), and its row in docs/reviews/ask-history.md. A JSON file of this folder that is not a run is under left_out, with why; tests/test_session1315.py holds that every file is one or the other.
